name: LOLIN C3 Mini
notes: LOLIN (WEMOS) C3 Mini v2.1.0: 34.3 x 25.4 mm, bare ESP32-C3FH4 (4 MB in-package flash), USB-C, ceramic antenna, LOLIN D1 mini footprint (single 8-pad row per side).

This page models v2.1.0. On the older v1.0.0 the LEFT column runs EN, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 3V3 (GPIO0-3 in the reverse order), the antenna is a PCB trace, and the LED is a plain blue LED. v1.0.0 also has notoriously weak Wi-Fi - capping TX power (e.g. WiFi.setTxPower(WIFI_POWER_8_5dBm)) is the standard workaround.
No USB-UART bridge: flashing and the console use the C3's native USB Serial/JTAG (GPIO18/19, wired only to the USB-C connector, not broken out). GPIO9 (BOOT button) is not broken out either.
Arduino defaults: TX=GPIO21, RX=GPIO20 (UART0), I2C SDA=GPIO8 / SCL=GPIO10, SPI SCK=2 / MISO=3 / MOSI=4 / SS=5.

2.note: Strapping pin with a fixed 10 k pullup on the board - avoid external pulldowns at reset. Also the Arduino default SCK.

7.label: LED
7.note: Drives the onboard LED: a WS2812B data-in on v2.1.0 (use the NeoPixel protocol / rgbLedWrite()), a plain blue active-HIGH LED on v1.0.0. Still usable as the pad is broken out.

8.label: SDA
8.note: Arduino default I2C SDA. Strapping pin with a fixed 10 k pullup on the board - do not pull LOW at boot.
